name: Naturalización por Matrimonio

requirements.blocker_text: Requires having been married to a Costa Rican citizen for 2 years and having remained in Costa Rica for that same 2-year period. The marriage must be registered in Costa Rica's Civil Registry.
requirements.fix_path: Remain married to the Costa Rican-citizen spouse and resident in Costa Rica for 2 years.

evidence_required.document: Criminal record certificate from home country or last foreign residence, apostilled/translated
Marriage registered in the Costa Rican Civil Registry

sources.title: Tribunal Supremo de Elecciones (tse.go.cr) -- Naturalización por Matrimonio

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Costa Rica's initial build. This TSE document (unlike cr_naturalisation_residence's) notably does NOT mention the Spanish/Social Studies exam requirement -- kept as an honest, direct read of the source rather than assumed to carry over from the residence-based track; a genuinely lighter-touch simplified procedure. Processing: 285 business days, free of charge.
